question: Since July 2016, World Trade Organisation (WTO) has ______ members.
solution:
The correct answer is __**164**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Since July 2016, the World Trade Organisation (WTO) has had **164 members**.
 
• The WTO is an international organization that regulates trade between nations to ensure smooth and fair trade practices.
 
• It was established on 1 January 1995, replacing the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT), which started in 1948.
 
• The WTO agreements cover goods, services, and intellectual property, laying down the legal ground rules for international commerce.
 
• Membership in the WTO allows countries to participate in the formulation of international trade rules and resolve trade disputes with other member countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The WTO has a unique system of trade dispute resolution, which is one of its most significant achievements.
 
• It operates a system of trade rules and provides a forum for negotiating trade agreements and settling disputes among members.
 
• The WTO's headquarters are in Geneva, Switzerland, and it operates as a forum for governments to negotiate trade agreements and settle trade disputes.
 
• Membership in the WTO is open to any state or customs territory having full autonomy in the conduct of its trade policies.
 
• The WTO also cooperates closely with other international organizations, including the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank.
